overview.title: Calcium silicate — the optimal choice for burn rooms
overview.description: Advances in materials make calcium silicate a practical balance of durability and heat resistance. TZJ interlocking liners are purpose-built for burn rooms that support live-fire training.
overview.lead: The interlocking tile system combines the hardest calcium silicate surface with factory-grade waterproof polymer to stand up to day-after-day live-fire training.
overview.body: Insulation performance is exceptional — during an interior burn, you can touch the exterior wall without being burned.

featuresSection.title: Six capabilities of interlocking liners
featuresSection.description: From interlocking assembly to NFPA-aligned design — protecting structure while keeping maintenance practical.

features.title: Interlocking assembly
features.desc: Tiles lock together for faster installation, inspection access, and single-panel replacement.

features.title: High-temperature rated
features.desc: Calcium-silicate composite withstands repeated Class A live-fire training temperatures.

features.title: Inspection-friendly
features.desc: Expansion joints and staggered channels allow independent tile movement and routine inspection.

features.title: Replaceable panels
features.desc: Local damage repaired by replacing individual panels — no full tear-out required.

features.title: Modular retrofit
features.desc: Upgrade path for existing burn rooms — new builds, retrofits, and damaged-structure repair.

features.title: Standards-aligned
features.desc: Designed to support NFPA 1403/1402 live-fire training requirements and domestic standards.

performanceSection.title: Built for demanding live-fire conditions
performanceSection.description: From material to construction, our liner systems are built for repeated live-fire training—protecting structure, supporting realism, and simplifying maintenance.

configSection.title: Tailored liner layouts for your burn room
configSection.description: Engineers deliver interlocking liner configurations based on room size, fuel type, and training objectives.
configSection.point1: Mounting channels, insulation buttons, and air gaps form a complete thermal envelope around steel or masonry substrates.
configSection.point2: Staggered panel layout maximizes airflow between liner and wall — maintaining insulation integrity through rapid heat cycles.
